articles.title: Brazilian companies turned to stablecoins on election day to dodge a currency crash
articles.snippet: USDT volume on crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin jumped nearly 800% and bitcoin volume surged 865%. Binance’s USDT/BRL market tripled while the global BTC/USDT pair fell.

articles.title: Robinhood taps Ripple’s $2.5 billion RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG
articles.snippet: Robinhood helped launch a rival dollar-backed token, USDG, but will also offer Ripple's stablecoin to retail customers later this year.

articles.title: Japan's top yen stablecoin falls short of its target in a disappointing first year
articles.snippet: CEO Noritaka Okabe blamed a 1 million yen per-transaction cap for Type II funds transfer providers, which has slowed corporate adoption.

articles.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
articles.snippet: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

articles.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
articles.snippet: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.
